layers.process: No more than 400 tourists at a time, held by a fixed number of licensed tourist beds. Confirm accommodation before booking flights. Strict biosecurity applies to protect against invasive species.

sources.title: Why only 400 people at a time can visit this paradise island (CNN, July 2024)

zone-requirements.note: Read the Lord Howe Island Board's own biosecurity and visitor rules. The lead time reflects how early beds fill, not a rule.
